method: Main A agent individually viewed each of the eight final 125-dpi Poppler page images in this chat via view_image, after final build; text extraction was supplementary.

Information and freeze-order prose, fresh-descendant equation and section transitions readable; margins and subscripts clear.
Formation table and numeric ranges complete, semantic admission limits and source-error paragraph readable; no clipping.

O0, six-row selection and final-outcome tables fully readable; captions and all four censor identities visible; no overlapping rules.
Full/effective costs, stage totals and six lineage rows align; captions readable and table references resolved; lower page margin clear.
Limitations, unchanged H0/default and pending S0 repository check retained; all six local references complete on this page, no orphan reference page.
